mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q01.stem: Contact resistance is not determined by material conductivity alone.
reasons: True is correct. Contact contamination, force and condition also affect resistance.
False is inappropriate. Contact contamination, force and condition also affect resistance.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q02.stem: A JIS mark and current calibration status require separate confirmation.
reasons: True is correct. The mark does not replace checks of current damage or calibration.
False is inappropriate. The mark does not replace checks of current damage or calibration.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q03.stem: The same two-component classification permits freely exchanging hardeners.
reasons: True is incorrect. The format can match while composition and specified combinations differ.
False is correct. The format can match while composition and specified combinations differ.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q04.stem: Test an unlabeled waste liquid's safety by mixing a small amount.
reasons: True is incorrect. Even small quantities can produce hazardous gas or heat.
False is correct. Even small quantities can produce hazardous gas or heat.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q05.stem: Comparing material labels and drawings takes precedence over visual impressions.
reasons: True is correct. Surface color does not replace a material certificate.
False is inappropriate. Surface color does not replace a material certificate.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q06.stem: A finishing tool dropped on the floor can be returned without checking.
reasons: True is incorrect. Foreign matter from the floor may be attached.
False is correct. Foreign matter from the floor may be attached.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q07.stem: Recording unusual-sound time and equipment name helps handover after stopping.
reasons: True is correct. These details make the event conditions easier to identify.
False is inappropriate. These details make the event conditions easier to identify.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q08.stem: An operator alone may decide to section shipping products for inspection.
reasons: True is incorrect. Sectioning changes the product and requires a sample plan and authority.
False is correct. Sectioning changes the product and requires a sample plan and authority.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q09.stem: Check thickness-gauge applicability when the substrate changes.
reasons: True is correct. The principle has conditions for substrate/coating combinations.
False is inappropriate. The principle has conditions for substrate/coating combinations.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q10.stem: For uneven thickness, maximum current is correct in every process.
reasons: True is incorrect. Excessive current can worsen appearance or deposition.
False is correct. Excessive current can worsen appearance or deposition.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q11.stem: Cupronickel and bronze have different principal alloying elements.
reasons: True is correct. Cupronickel mainly combines Cu with Ni; bronze mainly combines Cu with Sn.
False is inappropriate. Cupronickel mainly combines Cu with Ni; bronze mainly combines Cu with Sn.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q12.stem: Do not directly use a pure metal's melting point as an alloy's service limit.
reasons: True is correct. Strength or bonding can be affected below melting.
False is inappropriate. Strength or bonding can be affected below melting.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q13.stem: Near-neutral pH is suitable for every plating bath.
reasons: True is incorrect. Suitable ranges depend on process purpose.
False is correct. Suitable ranges depend on process purpose.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q14.stem: Phosphating and blackening cannot be interchanged by color alone.
reasons: True is correct. Phosphate undercoat function differs from blackening's role.
False is inappropriate. Phosphate undercoat function differs from blackening's role.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q15.stem: An aluminium alloy and a zinc coating have identical substrate roles.
reasons: True is incorrect. A substrate alloy and a thin surface coating have different roles.
False is correct. A substrate alloy and a thin surface coating have different roles.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q16.stem: If current changes, any single value can still represent the whole time.
reasons: True is incorrect. Changing current requires considering individual intervals and conditions.
False is correct. Changing current requires considering individual intervals and conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q17.stem: A scatter-plot relationship is not proof of causation.
reasons: True is correct. Other factors or biased data may also contribute.
False is inappropriate. Other factors or biased data may also contribute.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q18.stem: A white corrosion product is unconditionally harmless and shippable.
reasons: True is incorrect. Color alone cannot establish composition, safety or specification conformity.
False is correct. Color alone cannot establish composition, safety or specification conformity.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q19.stem: Basic acid-oxide classification considers reactions with bases.
reasons: True is correct. Acidic oxides are studied as reacting with bases to form salts.
False is inappropriate. Acidic oxides are studied as reacting with bases to form salts.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q20.stem: Record an extended waiting time after activation.
reasons: True is correct. A longer wait can affect surface condition.
False is inappropriate. A longer wait can affect surface condition.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q21.stem: Every chromate-based system has identical self-healing behavior.
reasons: True is incorrect. Functions differ with chemical species and method.
False is correct. Functions differ with chemical species and method.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q22.stem: Higher curing temperatures improve every paint film.
reasons: True is incorrect. Overheating can damage coatings or substrates.
False is correct. Overheating can damage coatings or substrates.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q23.stem: An oxidizing agent accepts electrons and is itself reduced.
reasons: True is correct. It oxidizes the other substance while accepting electrons itself.
False is inappropriate. It oxidizes the other substance while accepting electrons itself.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q24.stem: The equivalence-point pH is always 7 for every acid/base type.
reasons: True is incorrect. It can vary with acid and base types.
False is correct. It can vary with acid and base types.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q25.stem: For small holes, investigate substrate and prior processes as candidate causes too.
reasons: True is correct. Substrate and preceding processes can contribute as well as film formation.
False is inappropriate. Substrate and preceding processes can contribute as well as film formation.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q26.stem: For fixed resistance, voltage/current relationships can be compared.
reasons: True is correct. Align the fixed-R conditions for E=RI.
False is inappropriate. Align the fixed-R conditions for E=RI.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q27.stem: Recognizing an extinguisher sign means personally approaching every fire.
reasons: True is incorrect. Prioritize emergency reporting, evacuation and the responsible person's instructions.
False is correct. Prioritize emergency reporting, evacuation and the responsible person's instructions.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q28.stem: Dissolving something in 1 L of water always gives 1 L final solution.
reasons: True is incorrect. Final volume after adding solute need not equal the water volume alone.
False is correct. Final volume after adding solute need not equal the water volume alone.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q29.stem: Spraying is an application method and baking a curing method, different classification views.
reasons: True is correct. Application and curing are separate classification axes.
False is inappropriate. Application and curing are separate classification axes.

mfg1-surface-mock-05-theory-q30.stem: Current-density units are always only A, without area.
reasons: True is incorrect. Current density is per unit area and uses units such as A/dm².
False is correct. Current density is per unit area and uses units such as A/dm².
